name: Shijōnawate (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shijōnawate city emblem in white: a ring beneath a winged device with a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Shijōnawate, a city in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1970.

features.role: Shijōnawate city emblem — a ring beneath a winged device with a pointed top
